JOURNAL

YOU

The night the bell rang

The Gloomspire was not there yesterday. It rose over Ashmere in a single night, and at dusk a bell tolled from its top. With every toll, someone in town was simply gone.

Old Corvin, the bell-ringer who took in every stray Ashmere ever had, was the first. All twenty of you swore to bring him back.

The tower lets one fighter through each door, never more. So one of you climbs, and the rest ride the lift behind and keep a camp at the foot of every floor.

GAME MODE
SCOPE / OPTIC

Classic PvP: free-for-all, first to 10 eliminations wins.

Team 2v2 rules: two teams of two, shared team score, first to 10 team eliminations wins. Gun Only disables magic skills; Magic Only disables firearm attacks. Skill Test Room is a private practice arena with a stationary, non-lethal training target.
